what: R Interface to FDIC BankFind Suite API
title: R Interface to FDIC BankFind Suite API
text: R package retrieving data FDIC BankFind Suite API. FDIC BankFind Suite API allows : Search specific FDIC-insured financial institutions Collect branch office location data Explore annual branch office deposits institution location Review financial reports performance metrics institutions Get details failed financial institutions structural change events Retrieve historic aggregate financial structural data Obtain demographic data related financial institutions

text: obtained API key, recommend setting FDIC_API_KEY environment variable. title: R Interface to FDIC BankFind Suite API
text: function {fdic} accepts following arguments: api_key: FDIC API key (see Authentication ) filters: One filters apply requesting data using Elasticsearch Query String Syntax fields: One fields include response sort_by: field name sort response descending: flag specify direction sort_by (sort_by specified) limit: number records include response (maximum 10,000) arguments relatively straightforward, idiosyncrasies filters fields arguments worth discussing.
code: library(fdic)  # Retrieve qualitative information for active institutions in New York State, # sorted by total assets get_institutions(   filters = "STALP:NY AND ACTIVE:1",   fields = c("ASSET", "CITY", "NAME"),   sort_by = "ASSET",   descending = TRUE,   limit = 5 ) #> # A tibble: 5 × 4 #>       ASSET CITY          ID NAME                                              #>       <int> <chr>      <int> <chr>                                             #> 1 644997000 New York   33124 Goldman Sachs Bank USA                            #> 2 380997000 New York     639 The Bank of New York Mellon                       #> 3 254706000 Purchase   34221 Morgan Stanley Private Bank, National Association #> 4 212887157 Buffalo      588 Manufacturers and Traders Trust Company           #> 5  87511954 Hicksville 32541 Flagstar Bank, National Association

title: R Interface to FDIC BankFind Suite API
text: {fdic} contains eight internal datasets documenting current API endpoint definition files provided FDIC. dataset corresponds one functions contained {fdic} named prefixing endpoint fdic_ (e.g., fdic_institutions get_institutions()). dataset can accessed directly name, demonstrated . package development, noted fields returned API documented internal datasets. However, several instances fields either longer available new, undocumented fields added. {fdic} functions evaluate values supplied fields argument raise warning field returned response. However, can helpful call {fdic} function fields argument limit = 1 return current endpoint definition, demonstrated : Alternatively, BankFind Suite offers Glossary Variable Definition table may provide --date information API fields.

what: Retrieve Summary of Demographic Data for FDIC-Insured Institutions — get_demographics
title: Retrieve Summary of Demographic Data for FDIC-Insured Institutions — get_demographics
text: Queries /demographics endpoint FDIC BankFind Suite API, returning demographic data FDIC-insured financial institutions.

title: Retrieve Summary of Demographic Data for FDIC-Insured Institutions — get_demographics
code: get_demographics(   api_key = Sys.getenv("FDIC_API_KEY"),   filters = NULL,   fields = NULL,   sort_by = NULL,   descending = FALSE,   limit = 10000 )

title: Retrieve Summary of Demographic Data for FDIC-Insured Institutions — get_demographics
text: api_key (String) FDIC API key. Defaults value FDIC_API_KEY environment variable. Register key https://api.data.gov/signup/. filters (String) optional Elasticsearch query string filter results. field names values must uppercase. See examples refer https://api.fdic.gov/banks/docs/ full syntax details. Run fdic_demographics$field see available field names. fields (String Character vector) Fields include response. Defaults available fields specified. Run fdic_demographics$field reference. ID column always included response regardless fields requested. sort_by (String) Field name sort results . Defaults API default sort order endpoint. Run fdic_demographics$field reference. descending (Logical) results sorted descending order? applies sort_by specified. Defaults FALSE. limit (Integer) Number records return. Must 1 10,000. Defaults 10,000.

title: Retrieve Summary of Demographic Data for FDIC-Insured Institutions — get_demographics
text: tibble containing demographic data FDIC-insured institutions, one row per institution.

title: Retrieve Summary of Demographic Data for FDIC-Insured Institutions — get_demographics
code: if (FALSE) { # !no_creds_available() # Return demographic data for a specific institution get_demographics(filters = "CERT:10002")  # Return specific fields only get_demographics(   fields = c("CERT", "OFFSTATE", "OFFTOT", "REPDTE"),   limit = 5 )  # Sort by report date in descending order get_demographics(   fields = c("CERT", "OFFTOT", "REPDTE"),   sort_by = "REPDTE",   descending = TRUE,   limit = 5 ) }
